name: JRC-Names-Retrieval
description: Many systems rely on the ability to effectively search through databases of personal and organization entity names in multiple writing scripts. Despite this, there is a relative lack of research studying this problem in isolation. In this work, we discuss this problem in detail and support future research by publishing what we believe is the first comprehensive dataset designed for this task. Additionally, we present a number of baselines against which future work can be compared; among which, we describe a neural solution based on ByT5 (Xue et al. 2022) which demonstrates up to a 12% performance gain over preexisting baselines, indicating that there remains much room for improvement in this space.
reputation: A specialized JRC dataset used in name-matching and information-retrieval research; moderately known in the IR/NER community but not a broadly adopted general-purpose benchmark.
notes: Focuses on string-level name matching and retrieval/ranking; primarily an IR-style benchmark (not designed for LLM free-text generation). Can be sensitive to preprocessing and canonicalization decisions.
